name: The Thirsty Pirate
tagline: Your Story with Panicci Ventures — Video Testimonial
introHtml: Thanks for doing this — it means a lot. A few quick questions about our work together. Just talk naturally, 30–60 seconds each — and yes, the numbers in these questions are your real numbers.

questions.label: Intro
questions.text: Introduce yourself — your name, your role at The Thirsty Pirate, and what the vibe is like on the water in Sint Maarten.

questions.label: Before
questions.text: Before Panicci Ventures, how did travelers find The Thirsty Pirate — and how much business were you leaving to chance?

questions.label: Why Sammy
questions.text: You're running a bar in the Caribbean and your web guy is in Las Vegas. Why Sammy — and why does that work?

questions.label: What We Handle
questions.text: What does Panicci Ventures handle for you — the website, Google presence, being findable to tourists planning their trip?

questions.label: The Numbers
questions.text: Real numbers: when travelers search for you, you're showing up on page one of Google — average position under 9 — with visitors finding you from the US and Canada before they even land. Do guests walk in saying they found you online?

questions.label: What's Working
questions.text: What's working best right now — and which result honestly surprised you the most?

questions.label: Working with Sammy
questions.text: How is working with Sammy different from other marketers — communication across time zones, speed, no lock-in contracts?

questions.label: Moment
questions.text: Is there a moment that made you think “this is working” — a table of tourists who found you on Google, a booked-out day?

questions.label: Recommend
questions.text: What would you tell another bar or tourism business that depends on travelers finding them online?

questions.label: One-liner
questions.text: Finish this sentence: “Working with Sammy P is…”

editingBrief: PARTNER TESTIMONIAL for Panicci Ventures, spoken by the owner of The Thirsty Pirate (Philipsburg, Sint Maarten — thirstypiratesxm.com). Goal: case-study proof for panicciventures.com and pitch decks. Produce a full-length cut plus one clip per segment. NUMBERS, MOMENT, and SAMMY are the hero clips; RECO and ONE are the ad closers. Trim dead air, burn in captions, keep the speaker centered, export per platformTargets.
